dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Grand Master! Honorary Knight! Thank goodness you're here!

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: Be careful! There's no end to these monsters... however many we kill, more keep coming!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Just as I thought... Well, they're about to get a shock to the system — we'll wipe 'em out faster than they can replenish their numbers! We just have to hold on until the Logistics Company is ready!
